done.why: After a few minutes I was only walking between scenic rooms with no goal, no puzzle and nobody to talk to. Nothing pulled me forward, so I quit.

about: An underground cave-and-dungeon exploration game. You arrive after a dream in which an old man tells you to seek him when you feel worthy. You then wander tunnels, a cliff and a shore with a lantern.

moments.note: Going south put me in pitch dark with a grue warning. It was a classic touch, but I had to guess to turn on the lamp.
The sword in the rock can't be taken. There was no hint about what to do with it.
The sunlit cliff oasis with giant trees was a nice image. It also teased a rope, bread and something hiding.
I kept moving through rooms with no sense of purpose and no feedback beyond descriptions.

wished: A clear hint about the goal or the old man.
To examine the hidden something among the trees, which I skipped.
Something to react to besides scenery.

lines.line: Among the trees, unless you are mistaken, something that is not a tree is keeping very still.
lines.why: The one line that made me curious, but I moved on without following it up.

fun.why: The scenery was pleasant but nothing happened.

engagement.why: There was no hook after the intro dream, so I lost interest within a few moves.

difficulty.why: There was no clear goal, so I couldn't tell how hard it was. The immovable sword was a blocker with no clue.

interestingness.why: The setting and the dream intro had promise, with a sword in a rock, a hidden figure and an ocean.

prose.why: The room descriptions were vivid and atmospheric.
